title: Elevate UI Readability: Master CSS 'letter-spacing' for Optimal Text Density
tweet: Fine-tune your web typography! Learn how strategic CSS 'letter-spacing' improves readability and visual balance in UI design. #CSSTypography #WebDesign #UIDesign #UserExperience
tip: Overlooked 'letter-spacing' can significantly impact text legibility and the overall aesthetic of your UI. Use small, precise adjustments (often negative for display fonts, slightly positive for body text) to eliminate visual 'rivers' or overly dense character clusters, enhancing the user's reading comfort. Test across various font sizes and weights.
